author: Bog
description:
This tutorial showcases how to play Windows games on Mac using the free trial of the Crossover app. With the latest MacOS update and the power of Apple's gamer porting toolkit, It takes just a few steps to install Windows Steam games on MacBook and start gaming on Mac. Unfortunately, not all Windows games that are on Steam are available to play on Mac so you can play Windows games that are not available on MacOS through an app called Crossover or Parallels. This method of playing Windows games on Mac will work with any kind of device with MacOS that has an M series chip, whether it's the MacBook Pro M1, MacBook Air M5, or Mac Mini.

Crossover (Codeweavers) - https://bogxd.com/go/codeweavers
